description.value:
You spent years instructing others, and you learned that knowing something is only half the job — the real skill is teaching it well enough that it spreads. Whatever discipline you taught, you built a reputation for making difficult ideas click for people who'd never grasped them before.

You've likely been underappreciated for it more than once, but a small collection of former students still remembers exactly who taught them, and one or two of them owe you more than they'll ever say.

toolProficiencies: One instrument or set of artisan's implements of your choice
system.equipment: A set of common clothes, an instrument or set of tools you are proficient with, a token from a former student, and a belt pouch containing 50 credits.
